description: The chart ships its own image, and image.tag is deliberately empty so it falls back to the chart appVersion that release-please and CI set per release.

docker:pinDigests (via config:best-practices) writes the digest into that empty tag, which renders as `repo:@sha256:...` and fails the chart unit tests; a real tag here would also fight release-please.
Nothing else reads this image from a registry, so drop it from Renovate entirely.
